stories.title: Extract wmiau.go event loop to internal/infrastructure/whatsmeow/event_handler.go
stories.description: Move myEventHandler, connectOnStartup, startClient, safeGo, and MyClient type to internal package. MyClient.s was already removed in US-10 — now extraction is unblocked.

stories.title: Move remaining infrastructure files to internal/
